name: Blue livery
description: Bright blue all over, belly included. The ITA wordmark in silver-white over the forward windows with 'AIRWAYS' in spaced capitals under it. A paler blue fin, faintly patterned with icons of Italy, with green-white-red stripes running up its trailing edge and down over the tail cone. White engines with the tricolor flash.

logos.description: ITA's tricolor flash: a slanted green stroke rising forward with a smaller red wedge behind it (the white between is the cowling).

titles.style: The ITA wordmark: wide geometric capitals of thin-to-medium uniform stroke, the A's crossbar a small red wedge; over the forward windows.
Spaced capitals centered under ITA, the window line between them.

notes: The fin carries a faint pattern of small line icons (Italian landmarks and symbols) in a slightly lighter blue; not drawn. The ITA wordmark is lettering, so it's a title; its red crossbar wedge is described, not drawn. The tricolor on the fin runs parallel to the trailing edge, constant in width (so wider as a share near the tip). Winglets not seen clearly. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on EI-HOM (A320neo, fitted to the A320 shape): the fin's tricolor is narrower and further aft than drawn (at the root x 0.72-0.94, at the tip 0.37-0.99; about 0.4 m at the root); the tail-cone stripes agree. The titles start about 0.9 m further aft than drawn: ITA x 0.177-0.289, its foot on the window bottoms; AIRWAYS x 0.188-0.28 under the windows. Re-checked 2026-11-27 on I-ADVA and EI-HLE (A220-100, left sides): the engines' tricolor flash is about half the cowling's height, in its middle (it was drawn at a fifth).
history: Replaced Skyarium v1's approximation (green and navy). ITA Airways launched in October 2021 as Alitalia's successor with this blue scheme; ex-Alitalia aircraft were repainted into it.
